entities.summary: Paul Brady (b. 1947-05-19, Strabane) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Strabane and Ireland. Known in the fields of ireland, composers & musicians, europe.
